_comment: Renovate is the version-update bot for this repo. There is deliberately no
.github/dependabot.yml — running both duplicates every PR. Dependabot
SECURITY updates are a separate repo setting that needs no config file, and
are left ON as a backstop.
Renovate was chosen over Dependabot for two reasons specific to this repo:
it can manage npm `overrides` (every remaining advisory here is resolved
through one, and Dependabot ignores them entirely), and it handles the three
Two blind spots no bot covers — keep the CI jobs that do:
* npm audit runs as its own CI job; the old `tar` override pinned BACKWARD
onto a vulnerable version while looking like a mitigation.
* allowScripts keys are version-pinned, so a native-dep bump silently stops
the addon building. scripts/check-allow-scripts.mjs guards it.

packageRules.description: Group low-risk updates so the queue stays readable on a solo repo.
Protocol + credential layer. DESIGN §6.2 requires an exact pin and a source review before any bump — never automated.
better-sqlite3 13 requires Node >= 22; the bot image is node:20. Revisit with the base image, not on its own.
vue-tsc 3.x cannot load TypeScript 7 — it resolves typescript/lib/tsc.js, which TS 7 no longer exports.
Native addons need their allowScripts key bumped in the same PR or the build is silently skipped.
prBodyNotes: :warning: Native addon. `allowScripts` in the package.json is VERSION-PINNED — update the key to match or npm silently skips the build and `npm ci` still exits 0. CI's check-allow-scripts job will fail if they diverge.
